inlines.v: LICEN'TIOUS, adjective [Latin licentiosus.] 1. Using license; indulging freedom to excess; unrestrained by law or morality; loose; dissolute; as a licentious man. 2. Exceeding the limits of law or propriety; wanton; unrestrained; as licentious desires. licentious thoughts precede licentious conduct.
